text:
emma: Dropping a new pass on the routing editor UI. Main changes: collapsible mini-map, snapshot-level scrubber by default, and inline validation panes for rule cards. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC-routing-editor-v2
raj: saw it. Collapsible mini-map is great for cluttered policies. One question: if mini-map is collapsible, do we preserve its state per-user or per-policy?
lina: prefer per-user (persisted in user prefs). per-policy might be surprising when sharing links.
emma: noted. we'll persist per-user. clicking the mini-map should also be keyboard reachable and announce current viewport.
aria-a11y: Accessibility checklist incoming: mini-map needs a clear aria-label and a focusable control to toggle collapse. When opened, announce "Mini-map expanded, showing 5 groups, viewport on rule 2". If collapsed announce count only.
raj: scrubber UX: defaulting to snapshot stepping makes preview fast, but we should keep a "Detailed replay" button for token-by-token playback. Lina: can the replay copy be shorter? maybe "Play tokens" or "Detailed play"?
lina: "Detailed play" feels odd. "Play tokens" is clearer.
oliver: implementation note: token replay often blocks UI if we stream many events. Suggest we stream through webworker and throttle UI updates. Also provide a toggle to stream diffs only (primary vs fallback) to save bandwidth.
dev-bot: [CI] note: backend feature flag simulate_include_fallbacks is gated. Deploy PR #452 queued.
emma: great. For inline validations: idea is to show a small indicator dot on each rule. Clicking opens an overlay anchored to the card with details + suggested quick-fixes (like "add target", "specify model family").
aria-a11y: overlay must trap focus and move focus to the first actionable item. When closed, focus returns to the rule indicator. Also provide keyboard shortcut to open validator (e.g., Alt+V when card focused).
raj: copy nit for the global banner that appears when any validation is failing: current "Policy invalid" is harsh. Proposed: "Validation found issues in this policy 000(click to inspect)". Maybe add a tertiary "Run snapshot" button in the banner.
lina: shorter copy: "Fixes needed 000Review" with a lighter visual weight so it doesn't scream error.
emma: let's go with: "Validation found issues 00Review fixes" and include the Run snapshot CTA.
oliver: replay modal copy: "Play tokens" -> button should have a tooltip mentioning performance cost: "Token replay streams the model timeline and may be slow for long outputs."
raj: animation/transition: when rules reorder, animate card movement and simultaneously animate mini-map viewport to follow. If animation is interrupted (new reorder) we should gracefully snap to final state, not queue multiple animations.
aria-a11y: screen reader announcements for reorder: "Moved rule \"Block X\" from position 4 to position 1". Use aria-live polite. Also expose a condensed history for undo/redo via aria-describedby for power users.
dev-bot: [automated] Accessibility baseline: ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for badges, provide 2x focus indicators, and avoid color-only state for validators.
emma: fallback diffs in preview: show a compact side-by-side with headers: Primary / Fallback and small badges for latency & cost. Default collapsed; expand on click.
oliver: API contract proposal (testing only): GET /v1/policies/:id/preview?include_fallbacks=1 returns snapshots array. Example response snippet in docs:```json
{
  "snapshots": [
    {
      "id": "snap_01",
      "primary": "Hello there",
      "fallback": "Hi!",
      "metrics": {"latency_ms": 95, "cost": 0.004}
    }
  ]
}
```
lina: ux question 0: when showing diffs, should we highlight semantic differences (insert/delete) or just show raw text side-by-side with metric badges?
raj: semantic diffs are nice but expensive. Start with side-by-side and metric badges; we can add inline diff highlights later.
emma: action items:
- raj: persist mini-map collapse state per-user + refine animation behavior
- oliver: wire simulate_include_fallbacks flag and add docs + ensure webworker for token replay
- lina: finalize copy for banner, replay CTA, and validation indicator tooltip
- aria-a11y: post a short keyboard + screen reader checklist for this feature set
- emma: update figma with collapsed state and overlay mockups
aria-a11y: will post checklist in this thread. Also flag: ensure keyboard users can trigger the mini-map jump-to-block action (Enter/Space).
dev-bot: [automated] Thread summary: persist mini-map state, snapshot scrubber default, token replay modal, inline validation overlays, accessible focus management for overlays, replay performance notes, paired primary/fallback preview payloads.
emma: thanks team. aiming for design+accessibility sign-off at next sync. if no major objections I'll mark "design-approved" and open a handoff ticket.
